scope: EXPLORATORY_REAL_DATA; all DF005 price intervals already consumed; never confirmatory OOS
universe: Exact DF005 preselected 50 stock codes, including missing-price 494120 in the event missingness denominator. Reuse 49 nonempty cached histories only; no replacements or KIS requests. Current-survivor selection is not PIT.
event_definition: Original major report with exact normalized title 주요사항보고서(자기주식취득결정), or 자기주식취득결정, corroborated by original official document or official structured acquisition-decision fields tied to the same receipt. Whitespace normalization only. Decision is an intention, not actual acquisition and not BUYBACK_EXECUTED.
mapping: Use stock_code and corp_code on historical disclosure plus corroborating document identity; current corpCode mapping is diagnostic only and never sufficient proof of historical identity. Code changes and delisted gaps unresolved => quarantine and report.
corrections: Deduplicate exact rcept_no; conflicting revisions quarantine. Link correction to original only with official evidence, not title/date proximity. Apply linked cancellation/adverse or unresolved material correction only after its own availability: target zero, no new entry. Never rewrite original historical signal. Unresolved correction families quarantine prospective decisions from their availability.
availability: Keep actual acquisition timestamp distinct from historical counterfactual availability. Date-only rcept_dt is an interval [KST midnight,next midnight), not an actual publication timestamp. Model decision at 08:00 on first verified regular eligible session strictly after receipt date ends; modeled fill at that session open+1 second. Evidence-backed actual publication timestamp remains separate nullable field. No same-day entry, even if timestamp later obtained. Exclude special/delayed sessions and unknown calendar boundaries.
entry: Single D1 entry per original family, absolute sleeve target .25, no averaging or repeat entry. Reject if pre-entry correction invalidates. Same ReferencePortfolio accounting and hard cash constraints as prior studies. Nonexecutable entry expires after one minute, no assumed fill or later favorable replacement.
exit: Fixed 5 calendar-day maximum from first decision, exit at first eligible modeled open on/after deadline; previous completed close <= executed entry price*.95 or point-in-time correction invalidation triggers earlier exit. No future intraday stop inference. Retain pending/residual/HOLD until actual modeled executable tick; no forced terminal liquidation.
execution: RAW observed opens only, explicitly modeled not observed executions. Prior close +/-5% order limits, prior observed volume*.001 capacity, 1-share floor, adverse slippage and existing settlement/reservation rules. No halt/gap interpolation. Whole affected event window quarantined on missing calendar, zero volume or nonconstant RAW/ADJ factor without corporate-action lineage. No adjusted-price execution or extra dividend/split profit.
capital: 10000000 KRW per independent stock reference; .25 sleeve cap, no implication of pooled-account feasibility
cost_order: fee_bps,sell_tax_bps,slippage_bps,fill_fraction; research estimates, not verified historical tariffs; daily opex100 KRW, cash interest0. Costs charged once by ReferencePortfolio; slippage embedded in fill price only.
controls: CASH same daily opex; event-window BUY_HOLD .25 entry with same fixed deadline but no stop; frozen A0 same dates; trend control .25 only if prior close>=preceding20-close mean with same entry/deadline/stop/cost; same-stock non-event placebo at earliest eligible session>=20 sessions before event entry, with21 prior warmup and no known event in its prior5 or overlapping holding sessions. Missing control remains NULL, never favorable replacement. All controls use same capital and constraints.
diagnostics: Prior20 close runup, receipt-day close versus preceding close, entry open gap versus receipt-day close, modeled post-entry returns days1..5, same-market index exposure, A0 overlap, leave-one-company/month, top-company/date concentration, bear regime prior20 index return<=-.05. Industry attribution NULL absent PIT sector. No company/date/family duplicate independence claims.
minimum_evidence: 30 eligible original event families, >=10 companies, >=20 distinct entry dates, >=5 bear-regime events, matched trend and placebo controls for>=80% events; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. All counts reported even below threshold.
statistics: Descriptive first two annual intervals and final2024-10-17..2025-10-08 temporal diagnostic, all exploratory. Company-cluster bootstrap resampling complete company histories, B2000 seed606; date-block20 bootstrap on equal-weight independent-reference daily differences, B2000 seed607. Require both percentile95 lower bounds>0; Holm alpha.05 across D1-CASH,D1-TREND,D1-PLACEBO with centered two-sided p-values. Family fixed to acquisition decisions; disclose single-family limitation and overlapping date dependence. No independence claim from event count.
support: Only D_EVENT_EXPLORATORY_SUPPORTED if minimum evidence, BASE and STRESS net positive and cash/trend/placebo increments>=100000 KRW per 10M annual independent reference, both cluster checks and Holm pass, MDD/ES no worse than trend in>=80% matched references, bear net positive, largest company and entry-date shares of positive pnl each<=25%. Otherwise adequate evidence => NOT_SUPPORTED; insufficient => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; unavailable public events => DATA_BLOCKED. Never OOS, allocation or LIVE approval.
stop: No extra filters, alternative holding periods or family search after result inspection. Authentication/quota/secret/lineage failures halt collection safely; exhausted budget is not renewable authorization.
